candidates.title: The Compass That Pointed to the Dock
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the harbor compass pointed toward the dock instead of north before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they recalibrated it but the needle turned back toward the pier; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a newly installed iron winch was disturbing the needle; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the compass station away from the winch and checked bearings, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the museum's specimen drawer would not open before an exhibition before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they pulled the handle harder but the wood began to crack; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a paper label had slipped behind the drawer rail; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they removed the label with a thin tool and opened the drawer gently, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Kites That Would Not Rise
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered every kite at the festival dipped toward the same field before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they lengthened the strings but the kites still lost lift; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a line of tall trees blocked the steady wind; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the launch area to an open meadow and adjusted the tails, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
